title: デビュー戦の後に・荒

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just after the race…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: D-did you see her run?! This is just her debut race, right?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That's Narita Brian? She's so… wild.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Voices of astonishment spread like fire throughout the audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But as for Narita Brian herself…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Not bad. No one backed off, so it was a real fight until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: …Nothing. Let's talk about something else.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run in the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Asahi Hai F.S. is a G1 race that attracts the top junior racers. If I recall correctly, the distance is 1,600 meters on a turf track.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Apparently, my sister ran there her junior year. I also hear it's pretty tough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Well, that's all for me. I'm going to bed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm tired. Wake me up when it's time to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She collapses onto the sofa, looking abnormally low-energy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think back to how she looked during the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd thought she ran "wildly." But if I had to pinpoint what was out of place…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Agh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Right out of the gate, she was glaring at the other runners, running as if she was hyper-aware of all of them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seemed to be making a noticeable effort to forcefully overpower the others by changing her own pace whenever anyone came near her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She was exuding an unusual sense of intimidation and competitiveness…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, that very same Narita Brian is resting on the sofa behind me, sound asleep.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. Is Brian he—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, she's asleep? Hehe, she looks just like she did when she was little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's Biwa Hayahide, Narita Brian's older sister and an outstanding racer currently competing in the Classic Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thank you for taking care of my sister. I know she can be self-centered, and a handful at times…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But I hope you'll do your best to bear with her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: She's happy to be somewhere she can demonstrate her full abilities. She just has a funny way of showing it.
choice_data_list: Do you think she demonstrated her full abilities today?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …Well, it was her debut.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she must have been nervous. That's probably why she didn't seem to be running like her normal self.
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Speaking as someone who used to compete with her all the time, I can tell you her usual way of running is much more terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Once the trigger is pulled, that's it. No matter how far she runs, the thought of overtaking her opponent never leaves her mind.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …Oh, sorry. I should simply be praising her, considering she's my little sister.
choice_data_list: No, it's okay. This has been educational.
No, it's okay. This has been educational.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, my apologies. Now I've got you trying to make me feel better.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But all in all, it was a good run. No one can do it perfectly the first time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A lot of people used to keep their distance because of her strength. It must've been a new experience for her to run with so many others.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Anyway, please take good care of her moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I'm watching Biwa Hayahide leave, I realize how little I know about Narita Brian's past.
choice_data_list: I need to learn more about her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later, I notice something while I'm taking another look at Narita Brian's information.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She didn't take part in many scrimmages before her debut race. I'm sure there are many factors involved, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think that's what affected her this time. The prospect of racing with so many other people must've got to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a result, she couldn't run like usual and ended up extremely fatigued. What can I do to fix this?
